title: Complex materials engineering via Provenance Action Graphs: potential, structure and demonstration
title_zh: 通过来源动作图实现复杂材料工程：潜力、结构与演示

paragraphs.en: 本研究探讨了反应图在材料合成中的潜力，旨在通过编码合成规则加速材料发现进程。 This work discusses and tests the potential of reaction graphs for material synthesis, in which events consist of reaction steps (actions) and their outputs (observations). The importance comes from the requirement to synthesize technologically useful materials, especially those that are kinetically stabilized. Often, it is a science that follows years of trial and error, culminating in (published) successful recipes, but is truly driven by far more (unpublished) failures. The entry into the era of AI provides an opportunity to use learning algorithms to encode rules from multi-dimensional synthesis pathways, regardless of their technological usefulness, and to decode both forward prediction and inverse learning modes. The main incentive is to accelerate material discovery by generating a global knowledge base that can be shared among data agents and contributed to by them. We will focus on several scenarios in the common synthesis process during solid-state synthesis, primarily because these reactions are kinetic in nature and require closer monitoring and control of the reaction history.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究探讨了反应图在材料合成中的潜力，旨在通过编码合成规则来加速材料发现进程。这项工作讨论并检验了反应图在材料合成中的潜力，其中事件由反应步骤（动作）及其输出（观察结果）组成。 其重要性源于对具有技术实用价值的材料进行合成的需求，尤其是那些在动力学上稳定的材料。 通常，这是一门需要多年反复试验的科学，最终会形成（已发表的）成功配方，但其真正的驱动力却来自远多于这些的（未发表的）失败。 进入人工智能时代为我们提供了利用学习算法的机会，可以编码来自多维合成路径的规则——无论这些路径是否具有技术实用价值——并实现正向预测与逆向学习两种模式的解码。 主要动机是通过生成一个全球性知识库来加速材料发现，该知识库可供数据智能体共享，并由它们共同贡献内容。 我们将重点关注固态合成过程中常见合成流程中的若干场景，主要是因为这些反应本质上属于动力学过程，需要对反应历史进行更密切的监测与控制。
